mapper.select: SELECT R.ROLE_ID AS roleId , R.ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME AS roleDisplayName FROM ROLE R ORDER BY R.ROLE_ID

SELECT R.ROLE_ID AS roleId , R.ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME AS roleDisplayName , A.ACTION_ID AS actionId , A.ACTION_NAME AS actionName , TOP_M.TITLE AS lvl1 , MID_M.TITLE AS lvl2 , BTM_M.TITLE AS lvl3 FROM ROLE_ACTION RA INNER JOIN ROLE R ON RA.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN ACTION A ON RA.ACTION_ID = A.ACTION_ID LEFT JOIN MENU TOP_M ON A.TOP_MENU_ID = TOP_M.ID LEFT JOIN MENU MID_M ON A.MID_MENU_ID = MID_M.ID LEFT JOIN MENU BTM_M ON A.BTM_MENU_ID = BTM_M.ID WHERE R.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND RA.ACTION_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A.TOP_MENU_ID, A.MID_MENU_ID, A.BTM_MENU_ID, A.ACTION_ID DESC

SELECT R.ROLE_ID AS roleId , R.ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME AS roleDisplayName , A.ACTION_ID AS actionId , A.ACTION_NAME AS actionName , TOP_M.TITLE AS lvl1 , MID_M.TITLE AS lvl2 , BTM_M.TITLE AS lvl3 FROM ROLE R CROSS JOIN ACTION A LEFT JOIN ROLE_ACTION RA ON RA.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID AND RA.ACTION_ID = A.ACTION_ID LEFT JOIN MENU TOP_M ON A.TOP_MENU_ID = TOP_M.ID LEFT JOIN MENU MID_M ON A.MID_MENU_ID = MID_M.ID LEFT JOIN MENU BTM_M ON A.BTM_MENU_ID = BTM_M.ID WHERE R.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND RA.ACTION_ID IS NULL ORDER BY A.TOP_MENU_ID, A.MID_MENU_ID, A.BTM_MENU_ID, A.ACTION_ID
